title: Accuracy and Imbalance
outcome: By the end, I can explain accuracy and imbalance using a traced example and a stated limitation.
scenario: Show how a common healthy class can hide complete failure to detect spotted leaves.
given: Toy evaluation has 18 healthy and 2 spotted leaves. Always-healthy predicts all healthy. A candidate hasTP2, FN 0, FP 3, TN 15.
All inputs and outcomes in this worked example are invented classroom data; no real model run is claimed.

steps.label: Score trivial baseline
steps.detail: Always healthy is 18/20=90% accurate but detects0/2 spotted leaves.

steps.label: Score candidate
steps.detail: Candidate accuracy is 17/20=85%; spotted recall is 2/2=100%.

steps.label: Compare consequences
steps.detail: Candidate catches both spotted leaves while producing three false alarms; choose with stated costs and review needs.

explanation: Read the picture in order. Candidate catches both spotted leaves while producing three false alarms; choose with stated costs and review needs. The arrows show which recorded input or intermediate result each decision uses. Explain the deciding step aloud before checking the changed case; pointing to the final answer alone does not show how it follows.

counterfactual.change: The candidate’s three false alarms are corrected without changing its detections.
counterfactual.prediction: Candidate accuracy becomes20/20 with spotted recall still100% in this toy set.
counterfactual.reason: False alarms move from FP to TN; neither TP nor FN changes.

student_task: Why can the 90% baseline still be unsuitable for a detection task? Point to the relevant step in the picture, then write the changed result and the rule or evidence that supports it.
teacher_answer: It misses every spotted leaf. Accuracy is dominated by18 healthy cases; report class-specific errors and the intended-use consequences. Changed-case check: Candidate accuracy becomes20/20 with spotted recall still100% in this toy set. False alarms move from FP to TN; neither TP nor FN changes.
project_evidence: For your Responsible Plant Classifier, save the input, procedure, observed result and limitation of this check. Label this worked example as practice; use a different, previously unreviewed case when checking independent understanding.
limits: Perfect performance on twenty supplied cases does not demonstrate dependable detection in other plants or settings.
review_note: Reviewed Accuracy and Imbalance against the assigned lesson pack and its reserved independent case. Added a different explicit worked scenario, an auditable trace and a changed-input check; preserved the original curriculum and assessment boundary.
